finding: For every all-Hurwitz independent monic septic box with odd-root bands [a,b],[c,d],[e,f], no weak odd-canceling/eight-Vieta-vertex no-go can be supported at arbitrary nodes a<t1<t2<b<t3<t4<c<=d<t5<e and infinity, regardless of actual members, weights, or zero-odd atoms. Odd cancellation leaves two four-finite-plus-infinity rays; the same closed Vieta vertex F=(-t)(c-t)(d-t) has strictly positive even pairing on both. The all-box proof reduces the actual even upper-envelope to eight root-gap Vieta vertices, minimizes each ray over actual odd endpoint choices, and gives four exact algebraic case arguments using divided differences. The hardest case uses D=Oplus-Ominus, the identity D/[(f-t)(t-a)(d-t)]=(e-t)/(f-t)+(b-t)(c-t)/[(t-a)(d-t)], and ordered-node monotonicity. This extends the previous 11-parameter open example to all eligible odd boxes and all nodes in the displayed band placement. It does not address other placements, strict-negative certificates not in the odd-canceling formulation, six-or-more finite nodes or universal SPR7 existence.
